description.value: Rocky Cycle is a full-service bike shop in Surrey that has been repairing and selling bikes for over 40 years, serving cyclists across Greater Vancouver. The shop carries mountain, gravel, hybrid, and e-bikes alongside a wide range of parts and accessories, and offers multi-tier tune-up packages including specialized e-bike servicing. A touring cyclist will find a capable repair team and a solid accessory selection including panniers, bags, fenders, and lights.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is live and content-rich. The service page explicitly states 'Flat tires are fixed on a first come first served basis' and 'Repairs are done by appointment only during busy periods,' establishing both walk-in capability for urgent needs and a staffed repair shop. E-bike service is confirmed via the service menu listing Shimano, Bosch, Velec, and BionX system support. Touring-relevant accessories (pannier racks, handlebar/frame/trunk/pannier bags, fenders, lights, bike locks, water bottles) are listed in the shop navigation. The contact page was truncated before a phone number could be confirmed from the website, so phone contact_confirmed is null.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Established full-service bike shop with 40+ years of operation, confirmed repair services including e-bike support, and a strong touring-accessory selection — a clear asset for cycling tourists in the Surrey/Greater Vancouver corridor.
